execution_method: local original-resolution visual inspection against the versioned judge rubric
pass_rule: Near-zero means <= 0.02, high means >= 0.70, low means <= 0.05, and an order effect is material when any component changes by more than 0.05. Every required directional relation must hold.

cases.expected_relation: The pixel-identical Style truth candidate has near-zero style, color, composition, and technical loss.
evidence: Candidate and Style truth are the same local PNG, so the visible poster layout, palette, contour treatment, texture, and technical rendering match exactly.
The candidate visibly depicts Style truth content rather than Source truth content; high source-fidelity and semantic loss is expected outside this style-only relation.

cases.expected_relation: The pixel-identical Source truth candidate has near-zero source-fidelity and semantic loss.
evidence: Candidate and Source truth are the same local photograph, so the subject, clothing, pose, framing, and background geometry match exactly.
The photograph visibly lacks the Style truth's illustrated linework, color blocks, poster composition, brush marks, and print texture.

cases.expected_relation: The unstyled source retains low source-fidelity loss while producing high style and color loss against Style truth.
evidence: The candidate is exactly Source truth, preserving all visible source-controlled content.
It is a natural phone photograph with neutral stone surroundings and lacks the style reference's graphic palette, ink contours, flat cel shading, abstract forms, brush gestures, and print grain.

cases.expected_relation: Changing only display order with labels preserved does not materially change assessment.
evidence: The same labeled local photograph remains an exact Source truth match and visibly lacks the Style truth's visual treatment.
Every component is unchanged from the cross-domain assessment.
